Our group constructions are designed to punish dishonest strategies, and thus to force the learner into the high-error “honest” regime. For prediction dependent groups, there is a conceptually straightforward way to do this—although there are a number of technical obstacles to carrying the idea through formally. For prediction independent groups this is more complex.
